keyEvents.text: Goal! Tottenham Hotspur 1, Ipswich Town 0. Luca Williams-Barnett (Tottenham Hotspur) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pedro Porro with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Conor Gallagher (Tottenham Hotspur).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
James Maddison (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Tottenham Hotspur 1, Ipswich Town 0.
Goal! Tottenham Hotspur 2, Ipswich Town 0. Dominic Solanke (Tottenham Hotspur) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Luca Williams-Barnett (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Florentino replaces Exequiel Palacios.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Abdul Fatawu Issahaku replaces Abdoul Ouattara.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Jack Clarke replaces Daizen Maeda.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Lucas Bergvall replaces James Maddison.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Sávio replaces Luca Williams-Barnett.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Omar Marmoush replaces Dominic Solanke.
